description.item: Led the client integration process. Integrating client data into the Answer Rocket platform requires many Data Discovery meetings, ETL development, and understanding all cloud data warehouse environments.
Expertise on many popular cloud data warehouses (Redshift, Synapse, Big query, and Snowflake)
Assisted with updating and improving our in house ETL Tool kit API using Python and SQL.
Build custom client connectors (ETL) to transform complex data models into something that could be interpreted with the Answer Rocket tool.
Building custom ETLs for special data science projects, which require fundamental understanding of data science concepts.
Assisted the core development team by developing Python and Kotlin code to improve core Answer Rocket functionality.
Worked with Large datasets containing billions of rows for CPG (mostly Nielsen CPG data), Pharmaceutical, Legal industries.
Setting up initial data infrastructure on GCP using Big Query as the data warehouse and AirByte as a convenient way to easily pipeline data.
Architect data models for various use cases outlined by the business leadership team.
Implemented data models using DBT and custom python ETL/ELTs.
Using the tool Metabase, I designed and implemented a dashboard containing insights requested by the business leadership team.
Created and updated models using migrations with Entity Framework and C#.
Implemented unit tests to reduce errors and inconsistencies when implementing new code.
Worked on developing admin-based APIs that have helped the company transition away from ReTool.
Developed APIs using CRUD actions for our front end site.
